Bases: DataConfigABC

Configuration for model (predictor) dataset.

Parameters:

  • paths (str) – Path to dataset files.

  • names (list of str) – Variables to load.

  • preprocessing_pipeline (PreprocessingPipeline, optional) – Preprocessing steps applied to data.

  • ensemble_list (list or None, optional) – Specific ensemble members to select.

  • ensemble_mean (bool or None, optional) – Whether to compute ensemble mean.

  • concat_dim (str, optional) – Dimension along which files are concatenated.

  • file_type (str, optional) – File pattern (e.g., “.nc”).

  • rename_dict (dict or None, optional) – Variable renaming mapping.
